name: Molbergen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Molbergen (a red lion on white above a green clover leaf).
history: Municipal flag of Molbergen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Molbergen arms — lion and clover leaf
